About us

Behind the reels.

We capture the moments you’re busy living.

What we do

Your events, captured in reels. The Reel Wala covers private, corporate, social and cultural occasions, with event shoots on iPhone 16 or newer.

Private Events

Weddings & receptions; Mehendi, sangeet, haldi & make-up shoots; Birthdays & anniversaries; New car delivery; Baby showers, naming ceremonies & Annaprashan; Birthday parties & graduation days; Proposals & pre-wedding shoots; Pet shoots; Housewarming; Family gatherings & home tours.

Corporate Events

Team outings, lunches & dinners; Corporate parties; Annual & quarterly meetups; Office celebrations; Company anniversaries; Product launches; Sports & corporate tournaments; Store launches.

Social / Cultural Events

Cultural fests & carnivals; Diwali, Holi, Eid, Christmas, Gudi Padwa & other festivals; Community / society events; Music festivals & concerts; Stand-up comedy shows; Fashion shows & food festivals.

Book your shoot

Tell us where, what and when. Share your event or occasion details through the enquiry form; the team confirms your booking.

Reeler assigned

A professional reel creator is assigned to your event, and their details are shared with you.

Delivery within 24 hours

Your reels and photos are shared within 24 hours via a secure download link.

Packages

Standard includes 4 complimentary colour-graded photos and reel delivery within 24 hours. Extended includes up to 4 hours of shoot time, 7 complimentary colour-graded photos and reel delivery within 24 hours. Extra shoot time is ₹1,000 per hour. Base prices, Premium details and taxes are confirmed with the team before booking.

Already have the clips?

Send three or four videos through our reel-editing flow and choose an editing style. An editor handles the cut, colour and music according to the agreed brief.

Create with us

Register, attend the workshop, receive shoots and get paid after shoots. Apply with an iPhone 16 or newer, your locality and five of your best photos. Up to two edited videos are optional. Assignments and payment terms are agreed with the team.

Photography credits

Service illustrations use licensed photographs by JeegzArt Photography, Tirth Jivani and Pavel Danilyuk. These photographs illustrate the services offered. The reel-editing artwork is an editorial illustration.
